description.value:
Access You successfully performed a task set for you by Magdh or made a bargain with a norn to learn this spell.

You identify the ephemeral threads that tie a creature to its fate and sever them. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 10d10 spirit damage as you separate the creature from its destiny.

If the damage dealt by sever thread would reduce the target creature to 0 Hit Points, the creature remains at 1 Hit Point and becomes unmoored from its sense of self rather than being knocked out. It must attempt a Will saving throw, which has the incapacitation and mental traits. If the target fails the save, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4} for 1 month and loses its identity, memory, and any non-innate abilities. The target is no longer hostile or friendly to anyone, and if it has learned spells, it forgets them. If the target is a PC, they become an NPC under the GM's control. Only powerful magic such as a wish ritual can retrieve the target's original sense of self, causing it to regain all that was lost.
